releaseNotes: Observation photographs are now available from the shared Report photographs gallery throughout the report workflow.
Linked observations and photo evidence now appear on Circuit Schedule, Circuit Test Measurements, circuit result entry and Edit Circuit views.
Circuit Photos and Observations actions now open the linked evidence and show accurate counts.
Dashboard and report overview photo totals now include both general report photographs and observation evidence.
Preserves existing reports, backups, report locking and history, truthful no-result continuity records and PDF photo output.
